tc_barman.text: The Social Club. Céilí on a Saturday, and on a Friday, and on any day the boat doesn't come. Which is a lot of céilís.

tc_dancer.text: You learn to dance here before you learn to walk. The Tory dances go on until the generator gives up.

tc_box.text: The box, we call it. Push and pull, like the tide. Tory tunes are full of the sea; you can hear the swell in them if you listen with your feet.
